name: Anona Studio
website_meta_description: ANONA is a creative studio specializing in curated collections of exclusive artwork for the apparel and home industries. In addition to private appointments, ANONA presents the collection at Premiere Vision NY and Paris.

About — Anona Studio Design Archive Studio About Contact Design Archive Studio About Contact Founded in 2011, ANONA is a creative studio specializing in exclusive artwork for the apparel and home industries, with a special focus on kids design. With a versatile range of skills, a love of clever references, and expertise in hand-painted artwork, we create designs that are fresh yet timeless—always with a playful twist of the unexpected. Services: Original Print Design - Exclusive designs from our collection archive. Bespoke Print Design - Designed with your specific brief in mind, a commissioned artwork can be created for your exact needs and timeline. Please contact us for details. CAD Services - Color matching, colorways, color separation/ indexing, motif changes or swaps, repeats and re-works to industry standards. Vintage rework - Have you found the perfect vintage piece but need it updated and digitized? We can reimagine your vintage creating a production-ready piece. Follow Instagram Pinterest © 2026 ANONA Studio. All Rights Reserved.
